description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity Levy of 10% or Rs. 50 per kg. on importation of fish, w.e.f. 07.06.2017
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory order under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, which modifies import duties on fish. It constitutes a legal/regulatory instrument that amends existing financial regulations rather than dealing with government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the regulatory function, and the content does not focus on the minister's appointment or portfolio responsibilities in detail.
